description: Video highlight links for a match (or for a date / league). Returns title, video url + embedUrl, source, and the associated match. Example: highlightly_highlights({ sport: "football", matchId: 123456, _apiKey: "your-key" })

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to list highlights for (optional)

leagueId.description: Numeric league ID to filter by (optional)

matchId.description: Numeric match ID to fetch highlights for (optional)

sport.description: Sport slug. Default "football" (soccer). "soccer" is normalized to "football".

name: highlightly_highlights
